name: QEM-based Vertex Relocation
aliases: Quadric Error Metric minimization for DMC
definition: A vertex relocation method used in the Mesh Generation phase to move vertices to the isosurface, using the Quadric Error Metric (QEM) instead of full QEF minimization to reduce computational complexity and register usage on parallel hardware.
summary: QEM-based Vertex Relocation improves mesh quality by minimizing a Quadric Error Metric to snap vertices onto features, offering a computationally lighter alternative to full QEF minimization for performance-critical volume preservation.
